wishes: Theme: Pirate Adventure (with One Piece elements where copyright is ok). (No set name or number of variants was given, so the agent chose the name and the default of 3 variants.)
notes: How the wishes are applied. One Piece: only generic tropes the series made popular but does not own: a plain straw hat with a red band (A05), the giant cartoon roast on a bone (B06, B10), tangerines and a tangerine tree on deck (A02, B07, C08), a cheerful animal figurehead (a golden dolphin) on the crew's ship (A10, B09, C07, C10), and the crew's feast on deck (B10). Avoided: the names (One Piece, Straw Hat Pirates, Grand Line, character names), all characters and people, the straw-hat skull flag, the Going Merry (ram) and Thousand Sunny (lion) ship designs, the swirl-patterned Devil Fruit, the Log Pose, the snail phone, wanted posters, the Marine emblem and the heroes' weapons. No card text names One Piece, so the image model only sees generic descriptions. Collection: treasure hunting belongs to The Lost Island (chest, gold, jewels, X marks the spot), so this set has no treasure and stays at sea, aboard and in port. Family-friendly: no weapons (no cannons or swords) and no rum; the pirate flag is a friendly cartoon skull and crossbones, the public-domain symbol. Defaults changed: variant C (a port, places-led) uses 2/2/2/4 categories instead of 3/2/2/3. Validator overlap warnings answered: Straw Hat and Tricorn Hat are not the explorer's hat of The Lost Island (different hats; the straw hat is the producer's One Piece wish); Ship's Wheel is not the Spinning Wheel of Once Upon a Garden. Light: one warm sunrise or sunset accent per variant.

variants.concept: Set Sail!: the voyage begins, told through the crew's sailing gear and ending on the ship itself (classic pirate icons; One Piece nods: the straw hat and the ship's golden figurehead)
variants.moment: On a bright, breezy morning the crew rows out of the hidden cove, hoists the pirate flag and sets sail for the open sea.

cards.name: Spyglass
cards.subject: A pirate's brass spyglass (telescope) drawn thick and chunky, extended in three stepped sections, floating diagonally from lower left to upper right in three-quarter view, with a rounded eyepiece and a wide glass lens at the front; simple smooth shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a band of red leather wrapped around the widest section
cards.main_colors: golden brass and red leather
cards.background: Saturated purple background with a smooth light-to-deep gradient and a clearly visible pattern of small white four-pointed compass stars (the set motif) centred behind the spyglass; bright daylight.
cards.why: The lookout's tool that opens every pirate voyage; a small prop that says 'adventure at sea' on its own.

cards.name: Tangerine Crate
cards.subject: A small open wooden crate packed with a few big, shiny tangerines and some glossy green leaves, with thick rope handles on its sides, standing on a plain flat surface and seen from slightly above; simple, chunky shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a small black skull-and-crossbones painted on the front of the crate
cards.main_colors: bright orange tangerines and honey-coloured wood
cards.background: Plain flat light-blue surface and a smooth saturated blue gradient wall behind it, the same blue family; bright daylight.
cards.why: Provisions for the voyage: citrus kept sailors healthy at sea, and the painted skull marks it as pirate cargo. A light nod to the tangerine trees of One Piece; a crate of tangerines is a generic object.

cards.name: Compass
cards.subject: A round brass pocket compass drawn thick and chunky, its hinged lid open, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; a cream face with a big simple compass rose and a bold needle.
cards.unique_detail: a chunky red arrow-shaped needle
cards.main_colors: golden brass, cream face and red needle
cards.background: Saturated pink background with a smooth gradient and a clearly visible pattern of small white four-pointed compass stars (the set motif) centred behind the compass; bright daylight.
cards.why: Every voyage needs a heading: the navigator's small, unmistakable prop.

cards.name: Captain's Log
cards.subject: A thick, closed leather-bound logbook lying flat at a slight angle on a polished wooden tabletop, with rounded brass corner caps and a leather strap; chunky and simple.
cards.unique_detail: a big golden compass-star emblem on the cover and a red ribbon bookmark hanging out
cards.main_colors: warm brown leather and gold
cards.background: Polished honey-wood tabletop with a soft reflection under the book, and a smooth saturated green gradient wall behind it, clearly different in tone from the table; bright daylight.
cards.why: The captain's record of the voyage; the compass-star emblem ties it to the sea and to the set motif.

cards.name: Straw Hat
cards.subject: A wide-brimmed woven straw sun hat with a rounded crown, resting on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above and the front; the weave is drawn as big, soft, smooth bands, with no frayed straws.
cards.unique_detail: a bright red band around the crown
cards.main_colors: golden straw yellow and red
cards.background: Plain flat light-blue surface and a smooth saturated blue gradient wall behind it, the same blue family; bright daylight.
cards.why: The captain's beloved straw hat: the clearest One Piece nod that is still a generic object (a plain straw hat with a red band; no skull emblem, no character, no name).

cards.name: Rowboat
cards.subject: A small wooden rowboat with two oars resting in their locks, floating in shallow clear water at the edge of a sandy cove, bow turned toward the viewer at a low three-quarter angle; big, simple shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a little red-and-white striped pennant flying from the stern
cards.main_colors: red hull with a white stripe and honey-brown oars
cards.background: Shallow clear blue water and a wide band of golden sand as the ground, a few smooth rounded rocks at the sides, and a bright blue sky with a few soft clouds; bright morning light.
cards.why: Rowing out from the cove to the ship: the first step of the voyage, a small vehicle scene before the big ones.

cards.name: Ship's Wheel
cards.subject: A classic wooden ship's wheel with eight chunky turned spoke handles and a round brass hub, standing upright on its sturdy wooden pedestal on polished deck planks, seen from the front at a slight angle; drawn thick and simple.
cards.unique_detail: one spoke handle wrapped in red rope, marking straight ahead
cards.main_colors: warm brown wood and golden brass
cards.background: Polished honey-wood deck planks with a soft reflection as the surface, and a smooth saturated purple gradient wall behind, clearly different in tone; bright daylight.
cards.why: Taking the wheel is the signature moment of setting sail; the most precious object on deck.

cards.name: Jolly Roger
cards.subject: A black pirate flag on a short wooden pole, waving in a gentle curve and turned to show its broad side, floating in three-quarter view, with a big friendly white skull above two crossed bones in the middle; bold, simple shapes.
cards.unique_detail: the skull is round and cartoonish, with a wide cheerful grin
cards.main_colors: black and white with a honey-brown pole
cards.background: Saturated warm yellow background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the flag; bright daylight.
cards.why: The pirate flag is the genre's most iconic symbol. This is the generic, public-domain skull and crossbones, not the straw-hat skull of One Piece.

cards.name: Pirate Cove
cards.subject: A hidden pirate cove seen from a low angle: a crescent of golden sand and calm water enclosed by tall, smooth, rounded rocks that form a big natural arch toward the open sea, with a short wooden jetty running out into the water.
cards.unique_detail: the big natural rock arch framing the way out to sea
cards.main_colors: golden sand and warm sandstone rocks
cards.background: An early-morning sunrise sky glowing warm orange and pink above and through the rock arch, calm water reflecting the glow; the sand and water in front as a wide ground band; bright and saturated, never dark.
cards.why: The crew's hidden harbour where the voyage begins at dawn: the big place of the set, and its one warm accent (sunrise, counted as sunset light).

cards.name: Full Sail!
cards.subject: A cheerful pirate ship under full sail on the open sea, seen from a low front three-quarter angle, with a rounded wooden hull, two masts with big billowing cream sails and a black pirate flag at the top; a smooth hull with a row of round portholes; big, simple shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a big smiling golden dolphin figurehead at the bow
cards.main_colors: red hull with a yellow stripe and cream sails
cards.background: Bright blue sea with white foam at the bow as a wide ground band, and a bright blue sky with a few soft clouds; bright daylight.
cards.why: The climax: the crew's ship heading out to sea. The cheerful animal figurehead is a generic nod to One Piece's playful ships (a dolphin, not the Going Merry's ram or the Thousand Sunny's lion).

variants.concept: Crew Feast: the crew's happy life aboard between adventures (fishing, cooking, sea shanties), ending with a feast on deck at sunset; the variant closest to the spirit of One Piece (the giant roast on the bone, the tangerine tree on deck, the banquet), without any protected design
variants.moment: On a warm afternoon at sea the crew fishes, cooks and sings on deck, then gathers for a big feast as the sun sets.

cards.name: Dinner Bell
cards.subject: A shiny brass ship's bell hanging from a curved wooden bracket, with a rope pull hanging from the clapper, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; chunky, smooth and simple.
cards.unique_detail: a thick red rope pull ending in a big round knot
cards.main_colors: golden brass and red rope
cards.background: Saturated blue background with a smooth gradient and a clearly visible pattern of small white skull-and-crossbones symbols (the set motif) centred behind the bell; bright daylight.
cards.why: The ship's bell rings the crew to dinner: a small, unmistakably nautical prop that opens the feast story.

cards.name: Grilled Fish
cards.subject: A plump whole fish roasted golden-brown on a thick wooden stick, propped at a slight angle on a plain flat surface and seen from slightly above; smooth, simple shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a bright lemon slice and a sprig of green herbs on top
cards.main_colors: golden brown fish and a honey-coloured stick
cards.background: Plain flat light-pink surface and a smooth saturated pink gradient wall behind it, the same pink family; bright daylight.
cards.why: Fresh catch grilled on deck: the crew lives off the sea (fish on a stick is also how the One Piece crew eats on deck; the object itself is generic).

cards.name: Fishing Rod
cards.subject: A sturdy wooden fishing rod drawn thick and chunky, with a big round brass reel, bent in a gentle curve and shown diagonally, its short line ending in a round float; simple smooth shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a big round red-and-white float
cards.main_colors: warm brown wood, golden brass and red
cards.background: Saturated green background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the rod; bright daylight.
cards.why: Fishing over the rail is how the crew passes the afternoon, and how dinner is caught.

cards.name: Pirate Cake
cards.subject: A tall round two-layer cake with smooth white icing dripping over the edge and a thick red jam layer in the middle, standing on a plain flat surface and seen from slightly above; simple, chunky shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a little black pirate flag with a white skull-and-crossbones stuck in the top
cards.main_colors: white icing and red jam
cards.background: Plain flat light-orange surface and a smooth saturated orange gradient wall behind it, the same orange family; bright daylight.
cards.why: The crew's party cake, marked with the pirate flag: the feast's sweet centrepiece.

cards.name: Sea Shanty
cards.subject: A chunky button accordion (concertina) with red folded bellows between two wooden end boxes, standing upright on a polished wooden tabletop, seen from the front at a slight angle; simple and smooth.
cards.unique_detail: blue-and-white sailor stripes painted on the end boxes
cards.main_colors: red bellows with blue and white ends
cards.background: Polished honey-wood tabletop with a soft reflection, and a smooth saturated yellow gradient wall behind it, clearly different in tone from the table; bright daylight.
cards.why: Sea shanties are how pirate crews celebrate; the sailor stripes make the accordion a ship's instrument.

cards.name: Mighty Meat
cards.subject: A giant cartoon roast: a big round glossy roast of meat on a thick white bone that sticks out at both ends, floating at a slight tilt in three-quarter view; chunky, smooth and simple.
cards.unique_detail: a shiny golden-brown glaze with a sprig of green herbs on top
cards.main_colors: golden brown roast and a white bone
cards.background: Saturated blue background with a smooth gradient and a clearly visible pattern of small white skull-and-crossbones symbols (the set motif) centred behind the roast; bright daylight.
cards.why: The giant roast on the bone is the feast's signature dish: a generic cartoon food that no one owns, and the One Piece nod every fan will recognise.

cards.name: Tangerine Tree
cards.subject: A small round tangerine tree with glossy green leaves and a few big shiny tangerines, growing in a wooden barrel planter that stands on polished deck planks; simple, chunky shapes.
cards.unique_detail: the planter is a wooden barrel with shiny brass hoops
cards.main_colors: bright orange tangerines and glossy green leaves
cards.background: Polished honey-wood deck planks with a soft reflection as the surface, and a smooth saturated purple gradient wall behind it, clearly different in tone; bright daylight.
cards.why: A tangerine tree growing on deck: the crew's own little orchard at sea. A nod to the tangerine grove of One Piece, using only a generic tree.

cards.name: Ship's Galley
cards.subject: A chunky black cast-iron ship's stove with a big round red pot of bubbling stew on top, standing on the wide wooden floor of a cosy ship's galley, seen from a low front angle; soft natural white steam rises from the pot.
cards.unique_detail: a round brass porthole in the wall behind, showing the blue sea
cards.main_colors: red pot on black iron
cards.background: The galley's warm orange-painted plank walls filling the top of the image, with the round porthole; wide wooden floorboards as the ground; bright, cheerful light.
cards.why: The ship's kitchen where the feast is cooked: the big place inside the ship.

cards.name: Ship's Bow
cards.subject: The curved bow of a red-hulled pirate ship riding the waves, seen from a low front angle on the water, with a big smiling golden dolphin figurehead at the very front and the cream sails rising behind.
cards.unique_detail: the golden dolphin figurehead's wide friendly smile
cards.main_colors: golden dolphin figurehead and red hull
cards.background: Bright blue sea with white foam as a wide ground band, and a bright blue sky with a few soft clouds; bright daylight.
cards.why: The cheerful figurehead is the crew's favourite seat: a generic nod to One Piece's playful figureheads (a dolphin, not the ram or lion of the real ships).

cards.name: Deck Feast
cards.subject: A long wooden feast table on the deck of a pirate ship, seen from a low front angle, laid with a few big dishes only: a giant roast on the bone, a big bowl with a few tangerines and a tall cake; the ship's rail and mast behind.
cards.unique_detail: a small black pirate flag fluttering at the top of the mast
cards.main_colors: white tablecloth with red and golden dishes
cards.background: A glowing warm orange-pink sunset sky over the sea behind the ship's rail, wide deck planks in front as the ground; bright and saturated, never dark.
cards.why: The climax: the crew's feast on deck at sunset, the way every One Piece story arc ends; here with no characters, only the table.

variants.concept: Pirate Port: shore leave in a sunny pirate harbour town, from the hat shop to the shipyard, ending as the crew's repaired ship is launched (places-led, 2/2/2/4 categories)
variants.moment: On a sunny shore-leave day the crew roams a colourful harbour town, shopping and getting their ship repaired for the next voyage.

cards.name: Tricorn Hat
cards.subject: A black three-cornered pirate hat (tricorn) with a turned-up brim edged in gold, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; chunky, smooth felt with soft simple folds.
cards.unique_detail: a white skull-and-crossbones badge on the front and a big red feather tucked in the side
cards.main_colors: black felt with a red feather and gold trim
cards.background: Saturated warm yellow background with a smooth gradient and a clearly visible pattern of small white anchor shapes (the set motif) centred behind the hat; bright daylight.
cards.why: A new pirate hat from the harbour hat shop: the most unmistakable pirate prop for a common.

cards.name: Sea Chart
cards.subject: A parchment sea chart rolled up at both ends and open in the middle, lying on a plain flat surface and seen from slightly above; the open part shows a big simple compass rose and blue sea with two small islands, with no writing.
cards.unique_detail: a bright red ribbon tied around one rolled end
cards.main_colors: cream parchment, blue sea and a red ribbon
cards.background: Plain flat light-green surface and a smooth saturated green gradient wall behind it, the same green family; bright daylight.
cards.why: Charts are bought in port before every voyage. A navigator's chart, not a treasure map, so it doesn't repeat The Lost Island's treasure hunt.

cards.name: Anchor
cards.subject: A big chunky ship's anchor with a ring at the top, a crossbar and two curved flukes, a thick rope wound around its shank, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; smooth and simple.
cards.unique_detail: the thick rope is tied in a big neat sailor's knot
cards.main_colors: glossy red with a natural rope
cards.background: Saturated blue background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the anchor; bright daylight.
cards.why: Every ship drops anchor in port: the most recognisable nautical shape.

cards.name: Buckle Boots
cards.subject: A pair of tall black pirate boots with wide folded-down cuffs, standing side by side on a plain flat surface, seen from the front at a slight angle; smooth leather with soft simple folds.
cards.unique_detail: big shiny gold buckles on the front of each boot
cards.main_colors: black leather with gold buckles
cards.background: Plain flat light-pink surface and a smooth saturated pink gradient wall behind it, the same pink family; bright daylight.
cards.why: New boots for the next voyage: the tall cuffed boot with a big buckle is the pirate silhouette.

cards.name: Bottle Ship
cards.subject: A clear glass bottle lying on its side in a small wooden cradle on a polished wooden tabletop, with a tiny pirate ship inside it (a red hull, white sails and a little black flag) and a cork in the neck; simple and chunky.
cards.unique_detail: the tiny ship's white sails billowing inside the glass
cards.main_colors: red hull, white sails and clear glass
cards.background: Polished honey-wood tabletop with a soft reflection, and a smooth saturated yellow gradient wall behind it, clearly different in tone; bright daylight.
cards.why: The harbour's souvenir-shop classic: a whole pirate voyage in a bottle.

cards.name: Pirate Dock
cards.subject: A sturdy wooden harbour dock on thick posts running out over clear blue water, seen from a low angle, with chunky mooring posts and a coil of thick rope on the boards; big, simple shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a black pirate flag flying from a tall post at the end of the dock
cards.main_colors: warm brown wood and a black flag
cards.background: Clear blue harbour water around the dock and the wide dock boards as the ground, and a bright blue sky with a few soft clouds; bright daylight.
cards.why: Where pirate ships tie up on shore leave: the first big place of the port.

cards.name: Figurehead
cards.subject: A freshly carved ship's figurehead in the shape of a big smiling dolphin, painted shiny gold, standing upright on a sturdy polished wooden podium; chunky, smooth and simple.
cards.unique_detail: a wide friendly smile and a proudly curled tail
cards.main_colors: shiny golden yellow
cards.background: Polished wooden podium with a soft reflection as the surface, and a smooth saturated purple gradient wall behind it, clearly different in tone; bright daylight.
cards.why: The shipwright's new figurehead for the crew's ship: precious and one of a kind. A generic nod to One Piece's animal figureheads (a dolphin, not the ram or the lion).

cards.name: Fruit Stall
cards.subject: A small wooden market stall with a red-and-white striped awning, its counter holding a few big crates of shiny tangerines, standing on a sunny paved quay, seen from a low front angle; big, simple shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a round hanging sign with a single painted tangerine and no writing
cards.main_colors: red-and-white awning and bright orange tangerines
cards.background: A sunny yellow plastered wall of the market square filling the top of the image, with smooth paving stones in front as the ground; bright daylight.
cards.why: Restocking fresh fruit for the voyage at the harbour market; the tangerines are a light One Piece nod.

cards.name: Harbour Inn
cards.subject: A cosy, crooked timber-framed harbour inn with white walls, a smooth red roof, blue shutters and warmly lit windows, standing on a stone quay by the water, seen from a low front angle; big, simple shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a round hanging sign with a white anchor symbol and no writing
cards.main_colors: white walls, red roof and blue shutters
cards.background: A glowing warm orange-pink sunset sky behind the inn, with the stone quay and calm water in front as the ground; bright and saturated, never dark.
cards.why: The harbour inn where crews swap stories on shore leave (no drinks shown): the port's big landmark at the end of the day.

cards.name: Launch Day
cards.subject: The crew's freshly repaired pirate ship sliding down a wooden slipway into the harbour with a big white splash, seen from a low front three-quarter angle, with a red hull, two masts with billowing cream sails and a black pirate flag on top; a smooth hull with a row of round portholes.
cards.unique_detail: the golden dolphin figurehead at the bow, gleaming with fresh paint
cards.main_colors: red hull with a yellow stripe and cream sails
cards.background: The wooden slipway and the blue harbour water as a wide ground band, and a bright blue sky with a few soft clouds; bright daylight.
cards.why: The climax of shore leave: the repaired ship goes back into the water, ready for the next voyage.
